name: Four Seasons Hotel Los Angeles at Beverly Hills
positioning: Four Seasons hotel at 300 South Doheny Drive in Los Angeles, with a balcony on every guest room and a pool on the fourth floor
best_for: Guests who want a dedicated Wellness Floor
Guests who want to be minutes from Rodeo Drive and Robertson Boulevard shops

facts.text: The hotel has a total of 285 rooms.
The hotel is at 300 South Doheny Drive in Los Angeles.
Every guest room has a balcony with views of the Hollywood Hills or Downtown LA.
The hotel is located minutes from the Rodeo Drive and Robertson Boulevard shops.
La Ola serves coastal Mexican cuisine.
The outdoor pool is set on a tropically landscaped terrace on the fourth floor.
The pool water is kept at a sultry 79–81ºF.

highlights.text: Jeff Leatham's floral installations are in the lobby.
The hotel has a dedicated Wellness Floor.
6 poolside cabanas are available for spa treatments or a sheltered respite.
The fitness centre overlooks the pool and palm trees.

considerations.text: The Lounge is designed to transform with the seasons.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the Beverly Hills location.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
